title: Dave Dexter and Capitol's record dates
summary: They say Dave Dexter of Capitol arranged the record dates and the sidemen, like John Hammond for jazz.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Session players on the hits: "I played on that record"

blocks.x: Well, did he line up Norvel and your dates with Norvel and Bobby Sherwood and Red Nichols? Who lined those dates up?
He lined this up while you and Julia were on the Coast?
Yeah, well he loved jazz, a lot of wonderful liner notes but I didn't know that he went and made bookings too -- arranged bookings.
Well, it wasn't so much the bookings. It was after --
Capitol Record dates, right. He didn't book them into the joints. He booked them into the record dates, now I've got it.
He took care of the record dates. He was responsible for the different guys and the different people that they played with while they were on the Coast.
He evidently -- from what I hear about Dave Dexter, --
Yes, that's exactly what I've heard from everybody, that he's done more for jazz musicians. Well, he and John Hammond would be neck in neck in that respect.
